scope: complete mixture input; fixed encoded source clock
minimum_constant_clock_values: one effective tempo and at most one effective meter
tempo_reference: explicit initial source-MIDI tempo, unchanged within source support
meter_reference: explicit initial source-MIDI signature; missing defaults are unscored
source_presence_policy: paired stem WAV/MIDI files establish availability; metadata bookkeeping flags are recorded separately
absolute_phase_policy: unscored until an independent source-to-audio origin is established
declared_origin_diagnostic: source tick zero projected to audio zero; conditional diagnostic only
unit_hint_policy: reference BPM becomes a discrete unit hint after every audio family is prepared; no meter, event time or offset enters inference
parent_grouping: matched recording identity where available, otherwise source-MIDI identity
source_material: synthetic instrumental mixtures; not a real-recording generalization benchmark
